paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: The influence of number of blanks to .

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of blanks and accuracy for a specific model. The x-axis is labeled "# Blanks" with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 6 with a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 60%, also with a tick label interval of 20%. There is a single line in the plot which is light blue in color, with circular markers, and a solid line style. The line starts at 70% accuracy at 1 blank and shows a sharp decline, ending at nearly 0% accuracy by 6 blanks. This trend indicates a consistent decrease in accuracy as the number of blanks increases, with representative accuracy values of around 10% at 3 blanks and close to 0% at 5 and 6 blanks. A legend is placed at the right top corner of the plot
